name: Bon Jovi

whyMatters.en: New Jersey hard-rock band formed in 1983. Slippery When Wet (1986) put Richie Sambora’s talk-box guitar and large choruses on late-80s rock radio; Livin' on a Prayer is the main citation track.
whyMatters.zh: 新泽西硬摇滚乐队，1983 年成立。Slippery When Wet（1986）把 Richie Sambora 的 talk-box 吉他与大副歌送上 80 年代末摇滚电台；Livin' on a Prayer 是主要引用曲。

essentialTracks.title: You Give Love a Bad Name

lyricQuotes: Whoa, we're halfway there / Whoa-oh, livin' on a prayer
Shot through the heart / And you're to blame

shortBio.en: NJ hard-rock five-piece; Slippery When Wet talk-box hits; Livin' on a Prayer is the 1986 radio peak.
shortBio.zh: 新泽西 hard-rock 五人组；Slippery When Wet 的 talk-box 热单；Livin' on a Prayer 是 1986 电台峰值。

body.en:
Formed in 1983 in Sayreville, New Jersey. Slippery When Wet (1986), produced by Bruce Fairbairn with Desmond Child co-writes, is the main citation album: You Give Love a Bad Name opens on a stacked chorus, Livin' on a Prayer centers Sambora’s talk-box riff and gang vocal, and Wanted Dead or Alive moves from 12-string acoustic to electric.

New Jersey (1988) continues the same writing approach. Sambora left in 2013. It's My Life (2000) returned the band to rock radio with a new hit single.
body.zh:
1983 年于新泽西 Sayreville 组建。Slippery When Wet（1986，Bruce Fairbairn 制作；Desmond Child 合写）是主要引用专辑：You Give Love a Bad Name 以叠副歌开场，Livin' on a Prayer 以 Sambora 的 talk-box riff 与合唱人声为中心，Wanted Dead or Alive 从十二弦原声接到电声。

New Jersey（1988）延续同一写法。Sambora 于 2013 年离队。It's My Life（2000）以新热单让乐队回到摇滚电台。

body.en:
Bon Jovi write for chorus lift and Sambora talk-box as a clear guitar identity. Slippery When Wet sits in glam-metal and hard-rock radio alongside louder Los Angeles acts, with New Jersey working-class lyric framing.

Livin' on a Prayer is the citation track: talk-box riff plus gang vocal.

Arrangement follows Fairbairn polish and Child hook writing rather than thrash density.
body.zh:
Bon Jovi 为副歌抬升与 Sambora 的 talk-box 吉他识别写作。Slippery When Wet 落在 glam-metal 与 hard-rock 电台，邻接更响的洛杉矶乐队，歌词框在新泽西工人阶级题材。

Livin' on a Prayer 是引用曲：talk-box riff 加合唱人声。

编排走 Fairbairn 抛光与 Child 钩子写法，而非 thrash 密度。

title.zh: 带 Sambora 的 Slippery 五人

body.en:
Classic five: Jon Bon Jovi, Richie Sambora, David Bryan, Tico Torres, Alec John Such. Such left in the mid-1990s; Hugh McDonald became touring and studio bass.

Sambora left in 2013; Phil X later covered lead guitar.

Peak writing credits on Slippery When Wet and New Jersey are Jon, Sambora, and Desmond Child.
body.zh:
经典五人：Jon Bon Jovi、Richie Sambora、David Bryan、Tico Torres、Alec John Such。Such 于 90 年代中离队；Hugh McDonald 成为巡演与录音室贝斯。

Sambora 2013 年离队；后期由 Phil X 担任主音吉他。

Slippery When Wet 与 New Jersey 的巅峰写作署名是 Jon、Sambora 与 Desmond Child。

body.en:
Later stadium rock and some post-grunge acts borrow talk-box guitar and large-chorus writing more than the glam look.

It's My Life (2000) revisits the same hook approach for a later catalog hit.

Same FM era as Guns N' Roses: Bon Jovi’s polish versus GnR’s grit.
body.zh:
后来的体育场摇滚与部分后 grunge 乐队更多借用 talk-box 吉他与大副歌写法，而非 glam 造型。

It's My Life（2000）用同一钩子写法带回后期目录热单。

与 Guns N' Roses 同属 FM 时代：Bon Jovi 偏抛光，GnR 偏砂感。
